3982.name: Game Wizard Mercury
3982.content:
## PATENT PENDING

The Game Wizard Mercury is a compact and versatile machine that lives up to the Arcooda name. The Mercury features a 24 Inch Touchscreen monitor, authentic Japanese Sanwa joysticks and buttons, sturdy plywood build, and is compatible with your favourite late model consoles, PC gaming and current arcade VGA combo boards.The Mercury also creates a new playing field with pinball play and VR compatibility. Simply turn on your favorite pinball games or plug in your VR headset, and you're good to go!
